sources.text: chronicle step 5: the Mac's gatherer and fire line; voice.py budgets, skips and re-chains; Haiku 5.5 as the writer (8 Oct 2026)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Late at night, a voice branch joined the main line.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: A branch is a separate copy of the work, kept apart until it is ready.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The record shows the join, and nothing more about what was in it.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Then I will not guess. Glad it came home, though.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then came the next step, the Mac's gatherer and fire line.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: A gatherer, and a fire line. Sounds like camp.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The voice part got budgets, meaning a set limit, plus skips and re-chains.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Budgets, skips, re-chains. All of them in the voice file.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The record does not say how well they work. Only that they are in.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: And the writer changed too. Haiku is the writer now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A small Haiku model now writes the words.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Small model, big job. I like the sound of that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That is the whole record for this part of the day.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Quiet, but it counts. Every join is a step.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The branch came home, and the next step went in.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Good work, quietly done. I'll take it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That is the record. Over to you, March.
